INSERT INTO knowledge_bases(id,name,tenant_id,embedding_model_id,summary_model_id,type,chunking_config,indexing_strategy)SELECT 'portal-new-kb','New KB after Portal publication',tenant_id,embedding_model_id,summary_model_id,type,chunking_config,indexing_strategy FROM knowledge_bases WHERE id='future-private'

INSERT INTO knowledges SELECT(jsonb_populate_record(NULL::knowledges,to_jsonb(k)||jsonb_build_object('id','portal-new-doc','knowledge_base_id','portal-new-kb','title','PORTALNEWCANARY'))).* FROM knowledges k WHERE id='future-private-doc'

INSERT INTO chunks SELECT(jsonb_populate_record(NULL::chunks,to_jsonb(c)||jsonb_build_object('id','portal-new-chunk','seq_id',(SELECT COALESCE(MAX(seq_id),0)+1 FROM chunks),'knowledge_id','portal-new-doc','knowledge_base_id','portal-new-kb','content','PORTALNEWCANARY'))).* FROM chunks c WHERE id='future-private-chunk'

INSERT INTO embeddings SELECT(jsonb_populate_record(NULL::embeddings,to_jsonb(e)||jsonb_build_object('id',nextval(pg_get_serial_sequence('embeddings','id')),'source_id','portal-new-chunk','chunk_id','portal-new-chunk','knowledge_id','portal-new-doc','knowledge_base_id','portal-new-kb','content','PORTALNEWCANARY'))).* FROM embeddings e WHERE knowledge_id='future-private-doc'
